content:
The test suite failed because it attempted to use an unsupported '--recalculate' flag with the 'ssconvert' command-line tool.
The verifier failed with 'subprocess.CalledProcessError' during the execution of 'test_outputs.py'. The error message explicitly states: 'Unknown option --recalculate' when running 'ssconvert /root/output/result.xlsx /tmp/.../recalculated.xlsx --recalculate'. While the Excel file was successfully generated at '/root/output/result.xlsx', the verifier's dependency on Gnumeric's ssconvert for data-only validation blocked the final assessment.
